name: subms-runes
description: Runes - useful Claude Code skill packs. Each plugin is a themed pack; each skill is a rune you cast.

plugins.name: clipboard
plugins.description: Clipboard runes: clip (ask about what you copied - text/image/files), clip-edit (reformat/redact/convert and put it back), clip-save (save it to disk).

plugins.name: screenshots
plugins.description: Screenshot runes: shots (ask about recent screenshots), shots-save (copy a set to a folder), shots-tidy (rename/delete/archive in place).
